copy.headline: FacturAutentico Cloud - Para devs que construyen el futuro de las SMBs
copy.body:
**FacturAutentico Cloud — Now Available**

**Status**: Active | **Pricing**: $39/mo
**Stack**: Node.js 20+, TypeScript, REST API
**Auth**: API Key via header `X-API-Key`

**Features**:
• `api-access`
• `automation`
• `reports`
• `support`

**Docs**: https://tigerlab.dev/docs/facturautentico-cloud
**Support**: Discord ticket or victor@tigerlab.dev

To get started, book a diagnostic: https://cal.com/victor-tigerlab/diagnostic
